## History

Wace arrived in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) as a young minister alongside his wife, brimming with zeal for his new life's work during their honeymoon. He served as the town's local clergyman while residing at the manse with his spouse. Years later, he presided over the wedding ceremony of [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), marrying the couple in the sunlit orchard at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--wace.md)

Wace is the local minister's wife who formed a gentle, supportive friendship with [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shortly after arriving in the village. Their bond began when Mrs. Wace warmly comforted a distraught [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after a baking mishap and invited her to tea at the manse. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) holds a deep affection and excitement for Mrs. Wace, frequently praising her kindness to others.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005), +12 more_
